resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two 1936 newspaper items disagree: about ten miles south of Harrison in April, and about eight miles from Harrison in August. The readable sources do not settle which is right.
The register gives only the abbreviation AFC. The Forest Lookouts page names the Arkansas State Forestry Commission. The record's agency name is unresolved.

notes_for_editor: Current condition is the main gap. A search result (not readable) for a Facebook post from KHOZ 'Around the Table' (https://www.facebook.com/KHOZAroundTheTable/photos/the-old-fire-tower-on-boat-mountain-is-being-removed-ritter-communications-who-o/713667400762432/) has the headline 'The old fire tower on Boat Mountain is being removed' and says Ritter Communications owns the tower and lowered it by crane. The snippet is undated. fetch_text and WebFetch both got only a Facebook login page, so this is NOT used in the story and is unverified. If a human confirms removal, the story's today section and the record status (standing) must change. Suggested check: KHOZ or Harrison news, or Ritter Communications. The same snippet says the tower was manned by the Forestry Service in the early 1960s; that is also unverified. The 1956 staffing comes from the register's quote of a Harrison paper. The register's site visit (March 2022) is the last documented visit we could read. No photos added; the NHLR photo credits were not checked.
